Writing — Part 2 - Short text

What do you have for breakfast, and when do you eat it? Write 20-30 words.
questions.sampleAnswer: For breakfast, I usually eat a bowl of noodle soup or bread with eggs. I always have it at about seven o'clock, before I go to work every morning.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Hoa: Welcome to the Food Club! What kind of food do you enjoy cooking the most, and why?
questions.sampleAnswer: Thank you, Hoa! I love cooking traditional Vietnamese dishes the most, especially noodle soups. I enjoy them because the fresh herbs and spices make the flavour amazing, and my whole family always looks forward to eating them together.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Nam: When I don't have time to cook, I just order some pizza. What do you do?
questions.sampleAnswer: I understand you, Nam! When I am too busy to cook, I usually prepare something quick and simple, like a sandwich or fried rice. Sometimes I also order healthy food online, but I try not to do it too often.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 3 - Three responses

Linh: I think cooking is an important skill and people should learn it at school. What do you think?
questions.sampleAnswer: I completely agree with you, Linh. Cooking is a vital life skill that helps young people eat healthily and save money. If schools taught it, students would become more independent and confident when they finally live on their own.

questions.content:
Writing — Part 4 - Informal and formal emails

Write an email to your friend Mai. Tell her that you have joined the Food Club, describe your experience so far, and invite her to join a cooking activity with you. Write 40-50 words.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Hi Mai,

Guess what? I've just joined the Food Club, and I absolutely love it! The members are so friendly, and last week I learned how to make fresh spring rolls. We are having a fun cooking session next Saturday. Would you like to come and try it with me?

See you soon,
Linh

questions.content:
Writing — Part 4 - Informal and formal emails

Write an email to the manager of the Food Club. Suggest some advice for young people who have never cooked before but would like to learn, and say what you think is the best way to present this idea to them. Write 120-150 words.
questions.sampleAnswer:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing in response to your email about young members who have never cooked at home. I am glad to suggest some advice that could help them.

Firstly, I would encourage beginners to start with very simple, cheap dishes, such as fried rice or a basic omelette, so that they do not feel overwhelmed. Secondly, they should learn a few basic skills, like using a knife safely and controlling the heat, before trying harder recipes. Finally, cooking with a friend or family member makes the experience far less stressful and much more enjoyable.

In my opinion, the best way to present this idea is through short, step-by-step cooking videos on the club's website. Young people love watching videos, and they can easily follow and pause them at home.

Yours faithfully,
Linh
